text:
<subject>Re: Any plans for this evening?</subject>
<body>
Hi Martin,

Apologies for not getting back to you on Friday—I left a bit early and must have missed your message. Did you all have a good time on Friday night? How are things going with you?

It’s been quite busy here lately. I worked several late nights last week trying to catch up. I might have to postpone buying that new car, especially with the recent dip in Halcyon Mutual’s shares. They did rebound somewhat on Friday and earlier today, so fingers crossed it continues.

Have you been in touch with Simon since his wedding? I haven’t heard from him and imagine he’s just caught up in newlywed happiness.

Best regards,  
James

---

From: martin.bradshaw@greenfields.co.uk  
To: james.walton@halcyonbank.co.uk  
Subject: Any plans for this evening?

Hey James, what’s happening? My brother-in-law and one of his friends are flying into London tonight. We’re planning to head to The Arcade, a place similar to Dave & Buster’s, around 10 pm. We’ll probably hang out there for a while before heading downtown to find a bar. Some friends from my business school will be joining us too. Thought you might want to come along—are you up for it?

Drop me a message or call me at home: 020 7946 1234, or on my mobile: 07700 900123. I’m leaving work soon, so if I don’t reply by email, just give me a ring.

Cheers,  
Martin

---

From: james.walton@halcyonbank.co.uk  
To: martin.bradshaw@greenfields.co.uk  
Subject: Re: Second hotel room confirmation

Martin,

Thanks for sorting that out. I expect to arrive in Manchester before you. I’ll have my mobile with me (07733 456789). If you get in earlier, give me a call; otherwise, just ring my hotel room when you arrive. Sounds good—we can travel to the event together. I might bring along someone I’ve been seeing recently. We’ll see. The wedding is at 7 pm, right?

Thanks for the tip about the department store—I was going to ask about that.

Cheers,  
James

---

From: martin.bradshaw@greenfields.co.uk  
To: james.walton@halcyonbank.co.uk  
Subject: Second hotel room confirmation

James,

Good news—we managed to secure the second room at the same rate of £129 per night. Below are two confirmation numbers; either one should work for you or me. Both bookings are on my card, but you can transfer it to yours when checking in.

Not sure exactly when we’ll arrive since we’re coming from Sheffield. I estimate around 5 pm (the wedding starts at 7 pm, right?). We’ll actually be travelling on Friday since some of Sarah’s family from the Midlands will be there too.

If we don’t touch base before then, let’s plan to meet at the hotel between 6 and 6:30 pm and go to the wedding together.

By the way, they’re registered at Harrods—we bought a gift yesterday, but there are still plenty of items left on the list.

Martin

---

Please note:  
Airline security requires check-in at least 60 minutes before departure. A valid government-issued photo ID is mandatory.  
Airfares are per person and subject to change until ticketed. Please review your itinerary immediately and contact the Leisure Travel Department for any questions on 0345 678 9100, Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm.

</body>
